label: Figure 26.6: An increase in the supply of the Australian dollar
alt: Demand and supply diagram for Australian dollars priced in Singapore dollars, with the supply curve shifting rightward from S1 to S2, lowering the equilibrium price from 0.90 to 0.80 Singapore dollars.
caption: Demand for A$ stays fixed while supply shifts rightward from S1 to S2 (e.g. higher Australian interest in imports). The equilibrium price of the Australian dollar falls from P1 = S$0.90 to P2 = S$0.80, a depreciation, and the equilibrium quantity rises from Q1 = 100 million to Q2 = 125 million. Each A$ now buys fewer Singapore dollars.
